lettering.text: The field becomes still. The divine assembly faces Devī, and every word that follows is visibly attributed to the gods.
You are the power present through the worlds. You are knowledge and the fortune that sustains a household. You protect those who seek refuge. Your greatness is beyond the measure of our speech.

Even those struck down by you have reached heaven through meeting you in battle. Guard us with your gentle form and with your fearsome form. Let your trident, sword, bell and bow protect the directions around us.
